name: Skill Vetter
description: Security-first skill vetting for AI agents. Use before installing any skill from ClawHub, GitHub, or other sources. Checks for red flags, permission scope, and suspicious patterns.
author: spclaudehome

name: Self-Improving Agent
description: Captures learnings, errors, and corrections to enable continuous improvement. Records corrections and durable lessons in local markdown files for later review and promotion into agent memory.
author: pskoett

name: GitHub
description: Interact with GitHub using the `gh` CLI. Use `gh issue`, `gh pr`, `gh run`, and `gh api` for issues, PRs, CI runs, and advanced queries.
author: steipete

name: Google Workspace
description: Google Workspace CLI for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, and Docs. Requires the `gog` CLI installed via Homebrew.
author: steipete

name: Multi Search Engine
description: 16 search engines (7 CN + 9 Global). Advanced operators, time filters, site search, privacy engines, and WolframAlpha. No API keys required.
author: gpyangyoujun

name: Obsidian
description: Work with Obsidian vaults (plain Markdown notes) and automate via obsidian-cli. Search, create, move, and refactor notes.
author: steipete

name: Skill Creator
description: Guide for creating effective skills. Use when you want to create or update a skill that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
author: chindden

name: Auto-Updater
description: Automatically update Clawdbot and all installed skills once daily via cron. Reports what changed or failed.
author: maximeprades

name: Polymarket
description: Query Polymarket prediction markets. Check odds, find trending markets, search events, track price movements. Read-only market data helper.
author: joelchance

name: PollyReach
description: Gives every AI agent a phone number and the ability to get things done over the phone — finding contacts, making calls, completing tasks. Requires PollyReach account.
author: pollyreach

name: AutoResearch
description: Autonomous iteration loop: modify, verify, keep/discard against any metric. Bounded by default — override with unlimited iterations.
author: mxyhi

name: Browser Trace
description: Capture a full DevTools-protocol trace of any browser automation — CDP firehose, screenshots, and DOM dumps — then bisect into per-page searchable buckets. Debug failed runs and feed structured summaries back into an agent loop.
author: mxyhi

name: Diagnose
description: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test. Use when something is broken, throwing, or failing.
author: mxyhi

name: Exa Search
description: Use Exa for web, code, and company research via web_search_exa / get_code_context_exa / company_research_exa. Trigger when online search or parameter checks are needed.
author: mxyhi

name: Get API Docs
description: Fetch live documentation for third-party APIs, SDKs, and libraries before writing code. Ensures accurate, up-to-date API reference via chub instead of relying on pre-trained knowledge.
author: mxyhi

name: Grill with Docs
description: Grilling session that stress-tests a plan against the existing domain model, sharpens terminology, and updates CONTEXT.md and ADRs inline as decisions crystallise.
author: mxyhi

name: Improve Codebase Architecture
description: Find deepening opportunities informed by domain language in CONTEXT.md and decisions in docs/adr/. Surfaces refactors that turn shallow modules into deep, testable, AI-navigable ones.
author: mxyhi

name: Karpathy Guidelines
description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations. Avoids overcomplication, makes surgical changes, surfaces assumptions, and defines verifiable success criteria.
author: mxyhi

name: Planning with Files
description: Manus-style file-based planning using persistent task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md. Use for complex tasks requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.
author: mxyhi

name: Systematic Debugging
description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes. Always find root cause before attempting fixes — symptom fixes are failure.
author: mxyhi

name: TDD
description: Use when implementing any feature, bugfix, refactor, or behavior change, before writing implementation code. Enforces red-green-refactor through public interfaces, not implementation details.
author: mxyhi

name: PPTX Generator
description: Generate, edit, and read PowerPoint presentations. Create from scratch with PptxGenJS (cover, TOC, content, section divider, summary slides), edit existing PPTX via XML workflows, or extract text with markitdown.
author: mxyhi

name: Find Skills
description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", or express interest in extending capabilities. Bridges the open agent skills ecosystem.
author: mxyhi

name: Clean Design
description: Simplicity-focused design with ample whitespace, legible typography, and a limited color palette to reduce visual clutter.
author: typeui.sh

name: Dashboard Design
description: Dark-themed cloud-platform aesthetic with modular grids, glass-like panels, and strong data hierarchy for productivity dashboards.
author: typeui.sh

name: Minimal Design
description: Stripped-back design emphasizing whitespace, clean typography, and restrained color for maximum clarity and focus.
author: typeui.sh

name: Shadcn Design
description: Shadcn/ui-inspired design with minimal, clean components, monochrome palette, and utility-first patterns.
author: typeui.sh
